head: iOS 27: Apple Intelligence takes up to 16 GB, and a workaround
dek: People who updated to iOS 27 report that Apple Intelligence uses about 9 to 16 GB of iPhone storage, GSMArena writes. That includes phones in regions where the features aren't available, like the EU.
details: Turning off Apple Intelligence or Siri doesn't give the space back. A workaround shared by Reddit users and tested by GSMArena: set Siri to an English variant that Apple Intelligence doesn't support (Canadian, Irish, South African or New Zealand English), then restart; the space used drops to about 100 MB. Apple Intelligence and the new Siri features then stop working, because they need US or UK English.
means: If your iPhone ran out of space after iOS 27, Apple Intelligence may be the reason, and switching it off alone won't fix it.
todo: If you don't use Apple Intelligence, change Siri's language to Canadian, Irish, South African or New Zealand English and restart the phone. Changing your Apple Account's region isn't recommended: it can mean cancelling subscriptions.
